title: MVVM Pattern
description: Bind UI to data models using Model-View-ViewModel for maintainable apps.

data.text:
**MVVM Pattern**

Introduces a ViewModel that exposes data from the Model in a form the View can easily bind to, separating UI from logic.

data.title: MVVM in C#
Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: MVVM excels in WPF, MAUI, and modern XAML-based apps.
